title: Exotic Smoky Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Syrian dish featuring tender lamb in a smoky aoili sauce, cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the tagine and cook until fragrant.
Add the aoili sauce and tandoor spice blend to the tagine, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the tagine and cover with a lid.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 2.5 hours.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
